question: Wind energy is best harnessed in which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gujarat ranks among the top states in India for harnessing wind energy due to its geographical location and favorable wind conditions.
 
• The state has a vast coastline of around 1,600 kilometers, which contributes to consistent and strong wind flow, ideal for wind energy generation.
 
• Gujarat has several wind farms and projects, such as those in Kutch and Saurashtra regions, which are key contributors to wind energy production.
 
• The state has a well-developed infrastructure for renewable energy, supported by proactive government policies and investments in wind power projects.
 
• According to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Gujarat is one of the leading contributors to India's wind energy capacity, along with Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wind Energy in India:**

 
 
• India is the fourth-largest producer of wind energy globally, following China, the US, and Germany.
 
• Wind energy is a renewable and environmentally friendly source of power derived from the kinetic energy of wind.
 
• The Indian government aims to achieve 60 GW of wind energy capacity as part of its renewable energy targets.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of Wind Energy:**
 
 
• It is a clean and sustainable energy source, reducing dependence on fossil fuels.
 
• Wind farms have minimal operational costs once established.
 
• Wind energy contributes to reducing carbon emissions and combating climate change.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Harnessing Wind Energy:**
 
 
• Wind energy generation is dependent on location and requires high wind speeds.
 
• Initial installation costs for wind turbines and infrastructure are high.
 
• Land acquisition and environmental concerns sometimes pose hurdles in setting up wind farms.
 
 
 
• **Key Policies Supporting Wind Energy:**
 
 
• The National Wind-Solar Hybrid Policy aims to promote hybrid power projects for efficient utilization of infrastructure and resources.
 
• State Renewable Energy Policies, such as Gujarat's renewable energy incentives, encourage investments in wind energy projects.
 
• The Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) provides financial support for renewable energy initiatives, including wind power projects.
